scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @care-platform/api -w @care-platform/web -w @care-platform/public-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w @care-platform/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @care-platform/web
scripts.dev:public-web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @care-platform/public-web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @care-platform/mobile
